Heard Sri Diwan Saifullah Khan, learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State respondents.

2. The Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 3775 of 2022 has been filed praying to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 21.02.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 0076 of 2022, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504 IPC, Section 3/4 D.P.Act and Section 3/4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, Police Station Sadar Bazar, District Agra.

sentences.text: 4. Vide order dated 08.07.2022 the matters referred to the mediation centre.

5. Perused the office report dated 31.10.2023 and the settlement agreement dated 26.02.2023 which indicates that matter has been peacefully settled between the parties and they have settled their differences on the terms mentioned in paragraph 7 of the settlement agreement dated 26.02.2023.

The paragraph 7 is quoted as under:-
"7. The following settlement has been arrived at between the parties hereto:-
a) That the parties have already taken Talaq on 24.02.2023 by mutual consent and in this regard they have prepared a notarized Vivah Vichel Samjotha Patra which is being annexed to this settlement for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.
b) That it has been agreed between the parties that the applicant-husband shall pay an total amount of Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs only) to the wife by way of demand draft which shall include the amount of Mehar, Iddat, Muddat and Maintenance of the O.P. No.2-wife.
c) That out of aforesaid agreed amount, Rs.2,50,000/- (Rupees two Lakhs Fifty Thousand only) has already paid by the Applicant No.1-husband to the O.P.
No.2-wife by way of demand draft beairng No.098809 drawn on Indian Bank on 13.01.2023
before Civil Court, Agra and the O.P. No.2-wife acknowledges the receipt of the same.

d) That today i.e. 26.02.2023 the applicant-husband has handed over a demand draft bearing no.953351 dated 20.02.2023 for Rs.2,50,000/- (Rupees two Lakhs Fifty Thousand only) drawn on Indian Bank in favour of Shano (wife) and she has acknowledged the receipt of the same.

sentences.text: That the parties stated that demand draft bearing No.953351 has wrongly been mentioned as 933351 in para 6 of the Vivah Vichet Samjotha Patra dated 24.02.2023.

f) That it has also been agreed between the parties that all civil and criminal cases filed by them against each other regarding presenting matrimonial dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by talking appropriate steps before the Court/
authority concerned.
g) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other in respect of this matrimonial dispute.
They have no claim against each other in future also.
h) That it has been agreed between the parties that they shall not violate the terms and conditions of this settlement otherwise the aggrieved party will be free to take legal recourse."

6. It is submitted that as between the parties compromise had already taken place therefore, the impugned First Information Report dated 21.02.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 0076 of 2022,
under Sections 498-A, 323, 504 IPC, Section 3/4 D.P.Act and Section 3/4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, Police Station Sadar Bazar, District Agra as well as entire proceeding of the Complaint case No.2670 of 2018 (Smt. Asma Bi @ Shanoo Vs. Naim and others) and consequential summoning order dated 18.01.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate /
Additional Civil Judge, (J.D.) Court No.9 are liable to be quashed.
7.

sentences.text:
Thus, in view of the well settled principles of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court reported in 2003(4) SCC 675 (B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana), J.T. 2008(9) SC 192 (Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of investigation and another), (2012) 10 SCC 303 (Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab),
(2014) 9 SCC 653 (Yogendra Yadav and others Vs. State of Jharkhand) and also (2014) 6 SCC 466 (Narendra Singh Vs. State of Punjab), and in view of the settlement agreement dated 26.02.2023,
the First Information Report dated 21.02.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 0076 of 2022, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504 IPC, Section 3/4 D.P. Act and Section 3/4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, Police Station Sadar Bazar, District Agra as well as entire proceeding of the Complaint case No.2670 of 2018 (Smt. Asma Bi @ Shanoo Vs. Naim and others) and consequential summoning order dated 18.01.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate /
Additional Civil Judge, (J.D.) Court No.9 are hereby quashed.
